newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil govt seen defeating civil service amendment.
newsitem.headline: Brazil govt seen defeating civil service amendment.

text.p: The Brazilian government defeated a key amendment to its civil service reforms, according to a provisional count of votes in the lower house.
The electronic scoreboard showed the government had precisely the 308 votes needed to kill the amendment on job security. But officials ordered a recount before officially declaring the result.
The civil service reforms, which aim to do away with salary privileges for public sector workers and to end lifetime job guarantees, were approved on the floor of the house in April.
But the government had failed until Wednesday to muster the courage to force a vote on controversial amendments that threaten to make a mockery of the reforms by reestablishing job security.
